subject.title: feat(ui): gateway browser panel with annotate-to-prompt and element inspect in the web Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw core own this full first-party Control UI browser panel, including remote interaction, inspect, and annotation-to-chat, once the current correctness findings are fixed?
rationale: The linked feature issue is explicitly routed for maintainer product and security review, and this PR creates a large new first-party UI surface rather than repairing an established contract.

options.title: Sponsor the full panel
options.body: Keep the proposed gateway-backed browser, inspect, and annotation workflow in core after all blocking findings and focused proof are complete.

options.title: Narrow the first landing
options.body: Land a smaller screenshot-and-annotation surface while deferring remote input and element inspection until their interaction model is separately proven.

options.title: Defer the core feature
options.body: Close or pause this branch and retain the existing macOS browser plus external screenshot workflow until the product scope is reprioritized.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the full panel
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed gateway-backed browser, inspect, and annotation workflow in core after all blocking findings and focused proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged browser and Control UI history makes this person the clearest available owner for the core product-scope decision.
